title: The Glassblowers’ Hour of Hail
description: After the spring hailstorm, the glassblowers gather the ice in a brass pan. An apprentice watches the largest hailstone open into an iris.
alt: A glassblower and an apprentice kneel over a brass pan as a clear iris opens among hailstones on a wet terrace.
pairing: A glassblowers’ spring holiday × hailstones that open into glass flowers
